biocs.name: Compromised Process Accessed Rare External Host
biocs.description: A process that is not typically seen accessing a rare external IP
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.100'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'svchost.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'explorer.exe'
